_note: Per-channel defaults for studio.py. Content keys are top level; everything about how it LOOKS goes under 'style'. Command-line flags still override.
_style: size_div is a DIVISOR of the frame width, so a bigger number means smaller text. case: sentence|upper|lower|none. box draws a shaded plate behind the text; box_color takes ffmpeg colour syntax with alpha, e.g. black@0.5 or 0x1a1a2e@0.75. Anything here can also be overridden per caption in a staged overlays.json.
_fonts: Run list_fonts.py to see every font on this machine drawn with your own caption text. Keep a proportional face for captions: a fixed-cell pixel face such as Press Start 2P is about one em per character, so caption lines get shrunk hard to fit.
